summary: The document's preparers acknowledge that construction sediment could render portions of lower Howard Creek unsuitable for trout spawning for at least part of the construction period and a recovery period thereafter, but do not propose specific mitigation measures for this impact at this point in the text.
text: Sediment from construction activities could make portions of lower Howard Creek unsuitable for trout spawning for at least part of the construction period and for a period of recovery.
